exposure: Maternal hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) serostatus
cohort: The cohort consisted of 198,049 pregnancies registered in a population-based registry in Xiamen, China, from January 2015 to March 2019.
finding: Maternal HBsAg+HBeAg- was associated with higher risks of ICP and cesarean section, while HBsAg+HBeAg+ was further associated with higher risks of ICP, fetal distress, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Maternal HBsAg+HBeAg- was associated with a higher risk of cesarean section.
